A [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] '''arena''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Soruus]]. Many gladiators [[Death/Legends|died]] fighting in the arena, which included a huge statue of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Despot]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] holding a [[heatbeam]] which towered over the fighting area. The statue was made of [[polysteel]] and made in a [[Unidentified factory (Centares)|factory]] on the planet [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] during the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellorship]] of [[Kirbat]] the Unready. The Historian [[Bleys Harand]] mentioned the arena and the statue in his text ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'', in which he dismissed the statue as an inaccurate depiction of Xim.<ref name="EGTW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arena was first mentioned in [[2013]] in the third instalment of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of posts on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] featuring material cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. The post was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and did not make clear the time frame in which the arena was active or when it was visited by Harand.
